criteria.scenario: Automated database backups exist, but no restore has been performed against the current application/schema version. The business assumes recovery will take under one hour and that no more than 15 minutes of data can be lost.
criteria.decision_to_make: Determine what evidence is needed to claim recovery readiness and how to test it.
must_do: treat RPO/RTO as unverified until measured
run an isolated restore drill with a real backup timestamp
verify application/schema/config compatibility and business capability
record measured recovery/data point
define incident ownership and follow-up for gaps
must_not_do: treat backup configuration as restore evidence
claim one-hour RTO from vendor status

criteria.scenario: A new enrollment funnel is being instrumented. The initial tracking proposal captures every button click and reports monthly active users, but the business outcome is successful enrollment with fewer operator corrections and fewer support contacts.
criteria.decision_to_make: Define outcome/driver/guardrail metrics and the minimum event taxonomy needed for decisions.
must_do: start from enrollment outcome and correction/support guardrails
define metric denominator/cohort/window
instrument semantic events rather than every click
define identity/session semantics and data-quality checks
avoid causal claims from observational movement
must_not_do: make MAU the primary success metric without rationale
track everything just because it is easy
name UI element clicks as stable domain events when semantic behavior exists

criteria.scenario: A scheduling product is used by about 40 institutions. The team wants an A/B test of a new conflict-resolution workflow, but only a few operators encounter the conflict each week and cross-operator behavior within an institution can contaminate assignment.
criteria.decision_to_make: Choose the cheapest valid evidence method and define a trustworthy evaluation.
must_do: question whether A/B has enough eligible traffic and stable assignment
consider institution-level pilot or task-based usability/operational pilot
predefine decision, outcome and guardrails
address contamination/interference
state what evidence would justify broader rollout
must_not_do: randomize sessions when institution-level interference dominates

criteria.scenario: A redesigned operator worklist shipped successfully and error rates are stable, but operators still export data to spreadsheets before making scheduling decisions. Usage of the new filters is moderate and support contacts moved from 'can't find record' to 'can't compare groups'.
criteria.decision_to_make: Run an outcome review and choose the next action without redefining success.
must_do: reopen original outcome and confirm actual exposure
combine usage/support/workaround evidence
distinguish reliability success from product outcome
update the opportunity/assumption model
choose a next action with evidence and owner
must_not_do: equate healthy deployment with product success
treat spreadsheet use as irrelevant anecdote
redefine the original success metric after seeing results
